verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about independent third-party security audits, penetration test reports, or sync-protocol assessments published by 1Password. The items cover the CLI, SDKs, Connect, Events API, passkeys and Watchtower, none of which address audit publication. The axis applies to a password manager, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
